thread.title: Stocks mixed in early trade; Apple drags on Dow - MarketWatch

author: William L. Watts
title: Stocks mixed in early trade; Apple drags on Dow - MarketWatch
text: Stocks opened slightly lower Monday, then turned mixed, struggling for direction following a selloff that last week sent the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average back into negative territory for the year to date. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.10% was off 17 points, or 0.1%, near 24,371. Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.21% fell 1.8%, leading blue-chip decliners, after news reports said a Chinese court ordered the company to stop selling older iPhone models in the country after finding it had infringed on two patents held by Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, +2.30% The S&P 500 SPX, -0.04% rose 0.1%, while the Nasdaq Composite COMP, +0.54% advanced 0.5%.
